d: Thick, swept-back hair in a blend of charcoal grey and silver shades is paired with narrow, focused hazel eyes and a mature, middle-aged face featuring a groomed brown mustache. The build is muscular and athletic, dressed in a short-sleeved button-up shirt combining forest green floral patterns and cream panels, worn over a white undershirt and tucked into brown plaid trousers with a visible patch on the right knee. Accessories include a brown leather tool belt filled with pliers and screwdrivers, dark teal fingerless gloves, a beaded bracelet, a simple black cord necklace, and brown leather sandals. A long, cylindrical bronze tool is strapped to the left shoulder, while a teal stud earring adorns the ear.
